headline: Public hearings on projects at 19 Appaloosa Drive, 1-27 Independence Drive, and 11 Cross Street, plus violation notices for several addresses.
summary: The meeting includes three public hearings on filings for 19 Appaloosa Drive, 1-27 Independence Drive, and 11 Cross Street. It also covers a stormwater permit, several notices of violation, an enforcement order, and an emergency certification.
